notes.title: DLC #1 got released
notes.content:
Hey Players,

[b]The first DLC got released![/b]

This DLC is dedicated to all the fans that supported our game, your feedback & support not only made us motivated to work on the first DLC but also made it financially possible to release it for free.

What does it contain?

- [b]NEW WEAPON CUSTOMIZATION INTERFACE:[/b] yes we heard you, we noticed many of you want more customization for the equipment so now you will be able to choose the mod the weapons with scopes, barrels, and so on + it will also change the visual avatar of weapons.
- [b]NEW ARMOUR UPGRADE SYSTEM[/b]: yes, we heard you again, we now added a system that lets you have more control over the armor upgrade system.
- [b]NEW BALLANCE[/b]: because of the newly implemented systems we also had to adjust a large portion of the game balance to fit with the new additions.
- [b]NEW WEAPON/ FLAME THROWER[/b]: we received many suggestions during the private Beta test for a flame thrower and we promised we will add it after the release. Mission accomplished.
- [b]ABILITY TO CHANGE WEAPONS[/b]: yes we noticed that a huge amount of you wanted the ability to change weapons so we added it along with a new system for unlocking them. The weapons & mood schematics drop randomly on weapon crates and will immediately unlock them in the weapon crafting menu.
- [b]VISIBLE STATS[/b]: we now display some of the basic stats for each item in the Weapon/Armor menus, again this is based on the feedback we got although the main aim was to have players concentrate more on the tactical decision, not the numbers and that is why we preferred to make the DLC based on your feedback separated from the main game initial concept, which brings me now to the warnings section:


[b]WARNINGS:[/b]
- The DLC new system does not support the main game saves and the other way around
- The future UPDATES will be based on the new DLC system
- We did not change the initial inventory system from the main game build because many still enjoy that too

[b]News about future DLCs[/b]
Currently, we also hit the milestone for the second DLC that we will start work on as soon as we fix all issues based on your bug reports(if any) for the current DLC and have it solid.
The second DLC will contain a map editor but the price and final details are still not decided yet.


Thank you, players!

notes.title: UPDATE recap - the second week after release
notes.content:
Hey Players,

Here is a recap of all the game updates from the past 7 days aka the second week after release.


- BUG FIX: Spider boss fix
- BUG FIX: Trader encounter fix
- ADJUSTMENT: Achievement screen approvements
[b]- NEW: Hard dificulty achievements added[/b]
[b]- NEW: content +1 New Map for all map pools categories [/b]
- ADJUSTMENT: Research icon added to resource panel
- BUG FIX: selection by number of hotkeys fixed
- BUG FIX: save/autosave conflict fixed
- ADJUSTMENT: Dismiss button now has a confirm dialog box.
- ADJUSTMENT: Credits map updated
[i]- SUGGESTED BY YOU: swap heroes possibility in skilldex[/i]
- BALLANCE: More Armored zombies!
- BUG FIX: 10000 zombie achievement fix
- ADJUSTMENTS: some small text fixes


This being said, because we had such awesome positive feedback from you, we decided to immediately start work on our first DLC and because we reached some critical milestones we decided that [b]the first DLC will be free[/b]. More information soon.


If you enjoy our game and want to see it [b]grow even more[/b] you can support us by leaving an honest review on Steam.





Best Regards,
Cristian P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: First day after release
notes.content:
Hey players,


Thank you all for being here the first day after release!


-------------------------------------------------

[b]What is new?[/b]

1. [i]AUTOSAVE [/i]- we received many complaints about saving game cost resources and to be honest I do not agree with this change since it destroys a part of the intended game experience but still we decided to add an autosave in order to improve all player experience based on the feedback.
For those of you that are more hardcore, I recommend not using the auto-save

2. [i]BUGS FIXED[/i] - we saw the reports concerning some bugs encountered and my partner Sadoff fixed them, we shall continue to provide support so if any new bugs appear please use the bug report topic before you decide to rage-review the game lol, we read all reports.

- Police station map crash fixed
- Biobox object fixed
- some text fixes
- hotfix for some additional crashes

3. [i]SKILLS[/i] - we noticed many of you were confused about seeing characters level up but not having access to the skill screen until it gets unlocked so we hidden level up until the moment you also unlock the skill screen.


-------------------------------------------------


[b]How can you help us keep updating and expanding the project?[/b]

You can support this humble indie game by leaving an honest review.
[u]Reviews are critical[/u] for small indie game developers like us, a lot more than you realize.



Thank you!

Regards,
Cristian P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: 2021 update
notes.content:
Happy New Year!

Hope everyone is doing good, and now for some game-related news

I know that is been a while since this game is in development but I assure you we work constantly on it, it's just that the game appears harder to make than anticipated we feel the time pressure do not worry.
So we also had some more additions to the game core based on the feedback we received from people on our discord.
Recently we added a research screen, similar to Xcom, basically before you upgrade equipment or vehicle you need to first research that technology in order to access it. Here is a fast mockup of it:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695304/e8fa07b44b30d629ef8b879e4505e6e0f274c4fc.png[/img]

Also, many of you asked for more depth in the outside environment so we added city streets. Actual screenshot:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695304/c2c18bc3541b1349cf64f091fb624639985e3b62.png[/img]


In addition to this, we also made major changes to the travel map, the player can visit 1 zone per day and each day got action points that can be spent on exploring buildings or doing certain actions. Also, we split the management part into 4 tabs: inventory(player can upgrade characters equipment), skilldex (player can level up characters), workshop (player can upgrade vehicle), and R&D (player can unlock more upgrade possibilities)
Actual screenshot but not polished:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695304/5a84625ebbbd2770d41729ef58962ca7ec2cc8fa.png[/img]



Release date: we hope 2021 and we also hope to skip early acces.

If you want live updates or want to test drive the old alpha version, you can join our Discord community
https://discord.gg/J2E2YWK
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695304/deeceb5818888dd7bb2f12419c8e6294bbdd3481.png[/img]
